lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਹਛਾ ਸੋਇ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaa(n)daa hachhaa soi jo tis bhaavasee ||
lines.translation: That vessel alone is pure, which is pleasing to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਂਡਾ ਅਤਿ ਮਲੀਣੁ ਧੋਤਾ ਹਛਾ ਨ ਹੋਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaa(n)daa at maleen dhotaa hachhaa na hoisee ||
lines.translation: The filthiest vessel does not become pure, simply by being washed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guroo duaarai hoi sojhee paaisee ||
lines.translation: Through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate, one obtains understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਧੋਇ ਹਛਾ ਹੋਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: et duaarai dhoi hachhaa hoisee ||
lines.translation: By being washed through this Gate, it becomes pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੇ ਹਛੇ ਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maile hachhe kaa veechaar aap varataaisee ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself sets the standards to differentiate between the dirty and the pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਇ ਅਗੈ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat ko jaanai jaai agai paaisee ||
lines.translation: Do not think that you will automatically find a place of rest hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehe karam kamaai tehaa hoisee ||
lines.translation: According to the actions one has committed, so does the mortal become.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naau aap varataaisee ||
lines.translation: He Himself bestows the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਵਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaliaa pat siu janam savaar vaajaa vaaisee ||
lines.translation: Such a mortal departs with honor and renown; his life is embellished and redeemed, and the trumpets resound with his glory.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas kiaa vechaaraa tihu lok sunaaisee ||
lines.translation: Why speak of poor mortals? His glory shall echo throughout the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਸਭਿ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਸੀ ॥੧॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aap nihaal sabh kul taarasee ||1||4||6||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he himself shall be enraptured, and he shall save his entire ancestry. ||1||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਗਵੈ ਭੋਗੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee hovai jogavai bhogee hovai khaai ||
lines.translation: The Yogi practices yoga, and the pleasure-seeker practices eating.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਪੀਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tapeeaa hovai tap kare teerath mal mal naai ||1||
lines.translation: The austere practice austerities, bathing and rubbing themselves at sacred shrines of pilgrimage. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਦੜਾ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਬਹੈ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa sadaRaa suneejai bhaaee je ko bahai alaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Let me hear some news of You, O Beloved; if only someone would come and sit with me, and tell me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੇ ਜੋ ਖਟੇ ਸੋੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa beejai so lune jo khate sou khaai ||
lines.translation: As one plants, so does he harvest; whatever he earns, he eats.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਪੁਛ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸਣੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: agai puchh na hovaee je san neesaanai jaai ||2||
lines.translation: In the world hereafter, his account is not called for, if he goes with the insignia of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੋ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਾਢੀਐ ਜੈਸੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taiso jaisaa kaadheeai jaisee kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: According to the actions the mortal commits, so is he proclaimed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਸੋ ਦਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo dam chit na aavaee so dam birathaa jaai ||3||
lines.translation: And that breath which is drawn without thinking of the Lord, that breath goes in vain. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਚੀ ਬੈ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਲਏ ਵਿਕਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan vechee bai karee je ko lae vikaai ||
lines.translation: I would sell this body, if someone would only purchase it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ka(n)m na aavaee jit tan naahee sachaa naau ||4||5||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that body is of no use at all, if it does not enshrine the Name of the True Lord. ||4||5||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 7 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl, Seventh House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਡੰਡੈ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਭਸਮ ਚੜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog na khi(n)thaa jog na da(n)dai jog na bhasam chaRaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Yoga is not the patched coat, Yoga is not the walking stick. Yoga is not smearing the body with ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਮੁੰਦੀ ਮੂੰਡਿ ਮੁਡਾਇਐ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog na mu(n)dee moo(n)d mudaaiai jog na si(n)ngee vaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Yoga is not the ear-rings, and not the shaven head. Yoga is not the blowing of the horn.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai jog jugat iv paaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: galee jog na hoee ||
lines.translation: By mere words, Yoga is not attained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek drisat kar samasar jaanai jogee kaheeai soee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who looks upon all with a single eye, and knows them to be one and the same - he alone is known as a Yogi. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮੜੀ ਮਸਾਣੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog na baahar maRee masaanee jog na taaRee laaeeai ||
lines.translation: Yoga is not wandering to the tombs of the dead; Yoga is not sitting in trances.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਦੇਸਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਵਿਐ ਜੋਗੁ ਨ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jog na des disa(n)tar bhaviai jog na teerath naaeeai ||
lines.translation: Yoga is not wandering through foreign lands; Yoga is not bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai jog jugat iv paaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਤੂਟੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhetai taa sahasaa tootai dhaavat varaj rahaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, doubt is dispelled, and the wandering mind is restrained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: nijhar jharai sahaj dhun laagai ghar hee parachaa paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Nectar rains down, celestial music resounds, and deep within, wisdom is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਇਵ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai jog jugat iv paaeeai ||3||
lines.translation: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਐਸਾ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jeevatiaa mar raheeai aisaa jog kamaaeeai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, remain dead while yet alive - practice such a Yoga.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਜੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਵਾਜੈ ਤਉ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaaje baajhahu si(n)ngee vaajai tau nirabhau pad paaeeai ||
lines.translation: When the horn is blown without being blown, then you shall attain the state of fearless dignity.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan maahi nira(n)jan raheeai jog jugat tau paaeeai ||4||1||8||
lines.translation: Remaining unblemished in the midst of the filth of the world - this is the way to attain Yoga. ||4||1||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਕਵਣੁ ਤੁਲਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਵਣੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਬੁਲਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun taraajee kavan tulaa teraa kavan saraaph bulaavaa ||
lines.translation: What scale, what weights, and what assayer shall I call for You, Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇਵਾ ਕੈ ਪਹਿ ਮੁਲੁ ਕਰਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaun guroo kai pahi deekhiaa levaa kai pahi mul karaavaa ||1||
lines.translation: From what guru should I receive instruction? By whom should I have Your value appraised? ||1||
